  Expected change site: The single-file module step at `.github/workflows/ci.yml:2872-2965` (the `Orchestrate poll single-file module tests` step that follows the shard step at lines 2392-2462 in the same group 3 job) needs to overlap `tests/test_run_substate_ledger.py` with the four shards, not only with the other two single-file modules.
  Evidence of absence: Group 3 still runs the shard step and the single-file module step sequentially inside the same job. `if: strategy.job-index == 3` guards both steps, and the single-file module step only changes the order among its three modules (`sf_modules=(tests/test_orchestrate_poll_noop_suspicious_recovery.py tests/test_state_snapshot.py tests/test_run_substate_ledger.py)`). The four shards complete before any of the three single-file modules is launched. The diff comment and changelog fragment describe only the internal three-way concurrency, yet the processing report claims the recommendation is fully applied.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: .github/workflows/ci.yml 2899-2900 (the `sf_step_start_ms="$(sf_now_ms)"` capture). When `date +%s%3N` is unsupported or fails, sf_step_start_ms silently becomes 0 and no log line records that the clock is broken. Suggested fix: after the `case` fallback, emit one `::warning::CI_SUBTEST clock unsupported; elapsed_ms lines will be zero` line (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: .github/workflows/ci.yml 2911 (the EXIT trap). The trap does not re-raise a signal if the heartbeat was killed by SIGTERM/SIGINT during shutdown, so a runner cancel is swallowed. Suggested fix: append `kill -TERM "$BASHPID" 2>/dev/null || true` to the trap (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
